def gate(name,command,status=0,stdout=None):
    row=load("checks.json")[name]
    need(row["command"]==command and type(row.get("status")) is int and row["status"]==status
         and row["programmes"]==row["programmes_after"]==programs()
         and row["inputs"]==row["inputs_after"] and row["epoch_conserved"] is True
         and type(row["stdout"]) is str and type(row["stderr"]) is str,
         "complete committed actual gate command/status/programme/source epoch: "+name)
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):
        p=local(row[stream+"_path"],exists=False)
        need(str(p).startswith(".artifacts/raw-semantic-acceptance-20261011/checks/"),"own declared optional materialized gate stream")
        if p.exists(): need(p.read_bytes()==row[stream].encode(),"existing complete gate stream conserves")
    if stdout is not None: need(row["stdout"]==stdout and row["stderr"]=="","whole declared complete gate success")
    return row

        if row.get("surface_id")=="shipped_behavior":
            record=row["reference_contract"]["aggregate_change"]

            record["owner"]=OWN
            record["rationale"]="Document only verified partial original replay, two actual unchanged host guard interruptions and immediately owned blocked completion/stream recovery. No incomplete parent acceptance or native/private/higher promotion."
    return b"".join(canonical(row) for row in rows)
